name: pdscope
description: USB Power Delivery 抓包解析上位机 — 直接解析正点原子 ATK-C (.atkcc) 抓包文件
author: PDScope

scripts.ackcheck: node tools/make-test-atkcc.mjs --pd --out artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc && node tools/ackcheck.js artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc
scripts.pd:audit: node tools/pd-audit-profiles.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-wire.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-objects.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-vdm.mjs && node tools/build-standalone.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-browser.mjs
scripts.e2e: node tools/make-test-atkcc.mjs --pd --out artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc && node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc --expect-packets 12
scripts.e2e:ufcs: node tools/make-test-ufcs.mjs && node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop artifacts/_ufcs_synth.sqlite --out artifacts/e2e-ufcs.png
scripts.e2e:pdstream: node tools/make-test-pdstream.mjs && node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop "artifacts/_pdstream_synth.pdStream" --out artifacts/e2e-pdstream.png
scripts.e2e:ufcsstream: node tools/make-test-ufcs.mjs --stream-out artifacts/_ufcs_synth.ufcsStream && node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop artifacts/_ufcs_synth.ufcsStream --out artifacts/e2e-ufcsstream.png --expect-vbus 9 --expect-ibus 2
scripts.e2e:multi: node tools/make-test-atkcc.mjs --pd --out artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc && node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc --drop2 rawdata/DJIPOWER_VIVOX300U_PPS.sqlite --out artifacts/e2e-multi.png
scripts.e2e:all: npm run e2e && npm run e2e:powerz && npm run e2e:ufcs && npm run e2e:multi && npm run e2e:pdstream && npm run e2e:ufcsstream && npm run e2e:exports
scripts.test: node tools/version-check.mjs && node tools/syntax.mjs && node tools/build-standalone.mjs && node tools/selftest.js && node tools/pd-compliance.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-profiles.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-wire.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-objects.mjs && node tools/pd-audit-vdm.mjs && node tools/regression.mjs && npm run ackcheck && npm run e2e:all && node tools/pd-audit-browser.mjs
scripts.perf:worst: npm run perf:fixture && node tools/perf-probe.mjs --headed --file dist/PDScope.html --drop "artifacts/_worst.atkcc"
scripts.app:test: node tools/make-test-atkcc.mjs --pd --out artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc && node tools/tauri-e2e.mjs --drop artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc --shot artifacts/tauri-shot.png --report artifacts/tauri-selftest.txt
scripts.app:test:open: node tools/make-test-atkcc.mjs --pd --out artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc && node tools/tauri-e2e.mjs --open artifacts/_pd_synth.atkcc --shot artifacts/tauri-open.png --report artifacts/tauri-open-selftest.txt
scripts.check: npm test && npm run app:test && npm run app:test:open && npm run app:csv
